name: Marmite
description: Marmite is a Rust command-line static site generator for blogs that turns a folder of Markdown files into a site with Tera templates.
runtime: Rust binary (x86_64 release tarball; built from source on arm64)
notes: Benchmarked with minimal templates (base, content, list, group) and search, JSON feeds, sitemap, urls.json, Markdown sources, table of contents, related posts and next/previous links disabled. Marmite still writes tag, author, archive, stream and series pages, RSS feeds and its stock static files; none can be turned off by configuration. firstRelease from the first GitHub release (0.1.4, 2024-10-20).
